sourceFinding: CallSession.#finish retires and clears #call, clears #remote and disconnects/clears the pinned RPC. end() uses current #call and therefore cannot send an exact prior-call bye after this cleanup. Current local ended/uncertain state does not establish that a prior remote call ended.
result: No new call attempted because exact prior-call cleanup could not be established from this state.

offlineOfficialSourceReview.ringingTimeout: At character377577, startRingingTimeout defaults to60000ms and invokes local sendBye or expireUnanswered; it is a browser timer, not evidence of server expiry.
offlineOfficialSourceReview.transportTimeout: Around character378000, watchTransport uses15000ms only for a previously connected peer that then disconnects/fails/closes. It does not establish expiration of an initial failed ICE negotiation.
offlineOfficialSourceReview.byeRequiresPreservedContext: At character389029, sendBye retains the participant and UUID and sends msgGroupCall bye to that exact peer. Current laboratory state discarded that UUID.
offlineOfficialSourceReview.historyIsNotActiveCallProof: At character390000, updateCallLogStatus edits history metadata. A finished history record is not an authoritative active-call query.
offlineOfficialSourceReview.activeCallIsLocalUiState: Messenger-DUDPkifM.js character4887 subscribes to ve.active; it is not a server query.
offlineOfficialSourceReview.scopeLimit: This bounded cache review did not find a usable authoritative read-only endpoint or server TTL. It does not prove no such endpoint exists.

futureInstrumentation: Before any future call, retain one encrypted cleanup intent bound to account, device, peer, call UUID and call epoch; preserve it across media failure and distinguish local cleanup from a confirmed terminal action. No such cleanup was attempted in this audit.
